Rift Valley Views Stop-Over Dining Quiet Luxury Golden Hour Nature Escape Iten

Nestled on the edge of the escarpment.

The Cliff sits where the highlands break into the Rift Valley — a green-roofed stop between Eldoret and the valley road, built around one long view. Every table is framed by the same landscape that has drawn travellers, runners and wanderers to Iten for generations.

Come for an hour on the way through, or stay until the light turns gold over the escarpment. Either way, the table is yours.
